facts.sampled_slot_activation_behavior: Derives and persists one registry-bound immutable research work item, then exits
facts.deployed_intelligence_behavior: Runs four legacy independent run_once pollers in sequence while the kill switch permits

evidence.source_search_result: BoundedSampledSlotCoordinator and accept_stage are referenced only by their defining module and tests; the production intelligence worker entry point does not import or instantiate them
evidence.terraform_entry_point_result: aws_ecs_task_definition.intelligence starts opintel_intelligence_worker.main, not a bounded coordinator entry point

security_effect.exact_chain_not_proven: The deployed runtime cannot yet demonstrate that the registry-derived immutable Slot 01 activation is the exclusive input to M2-M5 or that every production stage consumes the exact accepted predecessor revision.
security_effect.unsafe_claim_prohibited: A local synthetic coordinator test cannot be represented as a deployed executable coordinator chain.
security_effect.authority_gate: READY_FOR_SLOT01_M1_M5_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION must not be issued until the production entry point and persistence path enforce the accepted coordinator.

minimum_successor.production_coordinator_entry_point: Add one bounded production command that resolves the immutable activated work item and advances only the exact accepted predecessor chain.
minimum_successor.durable_lineage: Persist coordinator artifacts atomically and reload/validate exact work-item, release, slot, package, business, hostname, stage and predecessor revision identities.
minimum_successor.release_application: Add a bounded hash-verified single-use release applicator or define an equally exact existing control-plane path; arbitrary SSM writes are not an executable authority envelope.
minimum_successor.network_authority: Only M1 may use the exact release-bound network path; M2-M5 remain offline.
minimum_successor.deployment: Build, publish, scan, plan and deploy a new immutable successor under fresh exact owner authorities.
minimum_successor.required_validation: Run the production entry point with synthetic/network-blocked fixtures and prove one immutable chain, no stage injection, no skip, idempotent recovery, terminal rollback, and Terraform NO_CHANGES.
